description: This is a Java source file that defines a helper class 'Log' for centralized logging and log node management within an Android project. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), and manages a linked list of LogNode objects for flexible log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to log messages at various levels and to manage a chain of LogNode objects. It mimics the android.util.Log interface but directs logs through a configurable node chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a VERBOSE message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an INFO message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a WARN message or Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an ERROR message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an ASSERT level message or Throwable.
